businessModel: Free browser monetised via Cốc Cốc search and start-page advertising/partnerships (details not verified)
updateCadence: Roughly every 2 months, version number ~6 ahead of Chromium base
summary: Cốc Cốc is Vietnam's leading local browser, built on Chromium with built-in ad blocking including YouTube, one-click video/music downloading and a direct torrent downloader. Desktop lags Chromium by about three months.
bestFor: People who want built-in video/music downloading
Users wanting an easy ad blocker without extensions
notFor: Anyone needing fast Chromium security patches

pros.title: Built-in ad blocker
pros.detail: Blocks ads including a separate YouTube mode without extensions.

pros.title: Video and music download
pros.detail: Downloads from YouTube, Facebook, TikTok and more without extra software.

pros.title: Torrent download
pros.detail: Direct torrent download built into the browser.

pros.title: Vietnamese-optimised
pros.detail: Local language and search tuned for Vietnam.

cons.title: Chromium lag
cons.detail: Windows 154.0.8037 (Aug 2026) ships Chromium about 148, roughly 3 months behind.

cons.title: Limited global support
cons.detail: Few non-Vietnamese resources and little independent security review.

cons.title: Telemetry unclear
cons.detail: Data practices are not transparently documented in sources found.

cons.title: No Linux
cons.detail: Official site lists no Linux build.

signatureFeatures: Built-in ad block with YouTube mode

faq.q: Is Cốc Cốc based on Chromium?
faq.a: Yes. Its major version runs about 6 above the Chromium base (e.g. 160 on iOS = Chromium 154).
The Android listing describes an AI Search feature summarising multiple sources. No full assistant was found.
Windows 10+, macOS 10.11+, Android 10+, iOS/iPadOS 17+ per the official site.

timeline.event: iOS 160.0.108 on Chromium 154; Android listing updated 2026-10-26 with AI Search

switching.note: Imports from Chrome and other browsers; Cốc Cốc account sync (unverified).

spec.patchLag: Desktop ~3 months behind Chromium (154 vs 148); iOS current

privacyDefaults: Ad block helps but little else
extras: Torrent, video download, YouTube ad block
beginnerFriendly: Simple, Chrome-like, download tools out of the box
